description: Personal health metrics from Health Sync / Apple Health / Samsung Health / Health Connect

panels.description: Canonical daily steps: Health Connect when available, otherwise Samsung Health. Workout step summaries are excluded.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric, r.original_type, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r
  JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'steps'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= (date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) < ((date_trunc('day', now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') + interval '1 day') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')
), by_source AS (
  SELECT source_name, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps
  FROM recent
  WHERE original_type = 'health_sync_steps'
  GROUP BY source_name
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name = 'Health Sync / Health Connect'),
  MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name = 'Health Sync / Samsung Health'),
  0
) AS "Steps Today"
FROM by_source

panels.title: Steps Today

panels.description: Longest non-awake sleep session for the latest local wake date. Segments separated by more than 30 minutes form different sessions; shorter sessions are shown as naps below.

targets.rawSql:
WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts, text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r
  JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment' AND s.source_system = 'health_sync'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= now() - interval '14 days'
), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes' OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session
  FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') / 3600.0 AS asleep_hours
  FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY asleep_hours DESC) AS rank_for_day FROM sessions
)
SELECT asleep_hours AS "Primary Sleep (h)"
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_for_day = 1
ORDER BY wake_date DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Latest Primary Sleep

panels.description: Latest direct heart-rate measurement. Workout track samples and workout summary averages are shown separately below.

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS observed_at, value_numeric, unit, original_type
  FROM health_observations_raw
  WHERE metric_type = 'heart_rate'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= now() - interval '30 days'
)
SELECT value_numeric AS "Latest Direct Heart Rate"
FROM recent
WHERE original_type = 'health_sync_heart_rate' AND unit IN ('bpm', 'count/min')
ORDER BY observed_at DESC
LIMIT 1

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS "time",
  value_numeric AS "Heart Rate",
  AVG(value_numeric) OVER (ORDER BY text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) ROWS BETWEEN 9 PRECEDING AND 9 FOLLOWING) AS "10-pt Moving Avg"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'heart_rate'
  AND original_type = 'health_sync_heart_rate'
  AND unit IN ('bpm', 'count/min')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS "Start",
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS "End",
  initcap(lower(r.value_text)) AS "Sleep Stage"
FROM health_observations_raw r
JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment'
  AND s.source_system = 'health_sync'
  AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric, r.original_type, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), chosen AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recent WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' AND source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect') THEN 'Health Sync / Health Connect' ELSE 'Health Sync / Samsung Health' END AS source_name
)
SELECT (date_trunc('hour', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", SUM(value_numeric) AS "Steps"
FROM recent CROSS JOIN chosen WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' AND recent.source_name=chosen.source_name GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric, r.original_type, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), chosen AS (
  SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recent WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' AND source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect') THEN 'Health Sync / Health Connect' ELSE 'Health Sync / Samsung Health' END AS source_name
)
SELECT (date_trunc('hour', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
       AVG(SUM(value_numeric)) OVER () AS "Hourly Avg"
FROM recent CROSS JOIN chosen WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' AND recent.source_name=chosen.source_name
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (date_trunc('hour', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(value_numeric) AS "Active Energy"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'active_energy'
  AND unit IN ('Cal', 'kcal')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS "time",
  value_numeric AS "SpO₂"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'oxygen_saturation'
  AND unit = '%'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts, text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='sleep_segment' AND s.source_system='health_sync' AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light','deep','rem','awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= $__timeTo()
), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts,ends)+interval '30 minutes' OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts,ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts,ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake') AS asleep_seconds FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), latest AS (
  SELECT session_id FROM sessions ORDER BY wake_date DESC, asleep_seconds DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT MIN(starts) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Sleep start (ET)", MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Wake time (ET)",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts)))/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Tracked hours",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Asleep hours",
  ROUND((100.0*SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage<>'awake')/NULLIF(SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))),0))::numeric,1) AS "Efficiency %",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='light')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Light h",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='deep')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Deep h",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='rem')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "REM h",
  ROUND((SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends-starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage='awake')/3600.0)::numeric,2) AS "Awake h",
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE stage='awake') AS "Awake episodes"
FROM segmented JOIN latest USING (session_id)

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS observed_at, value_numeric, unit, original_type
  FROM health_observations_raw
  WHERE metric_type = 'heart_rate'
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
)
SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  MIN(value_numeric) AS "min", AVG(value_numeric) AS "avg", MAX(value_numeric) AS "max"
FROM recent
WHERE original_type = 'health_sync_heart_rate' AND unit IN ('bpm', 'count/min')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS "time",
  value_numeric AS "resting_hr"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'resting_heart_rate'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  AVG(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'heart_rate_variability_rmssd' THEN value_numeric END) AS "rmssd_ms",
  AVG(CASE WHEN metric_type = 'heart_rate_variability_sdnn' THEN value_numeric END) AS "sdnn_ms"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type IN ('heart_rate_variability_rmssd', 'heart_rate_variability_sdnn')
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

WITH base AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS starts, text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.end_time) AS ends, lower(r.value_text) AS stage
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id = r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type = 'sleep_segment' AND s.source_system = 'health_sync'
    AND lower(r.value_text) IN ('light', 'deep', 'rem', 'awake')
    AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz - interval '1 day' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), marked AS (
  SELECT *, CASE WHEN starts > lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) + interval '30 minutes' OR lag(ends) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS new_session FROM base
), segmented AS (
  SELECT *, SUM(new_session) OVER (ORDER BY starts, ends) AS session_id FROM marked
), sessions AS (
  SELECT session_id, (MAX(ends) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS wake_date, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ends - starts))) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'awake') AS asleep_seconds FROM segmented GROUP BY session_id
), ranked AS (
  SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY wake_date ORDER BY asleep_seconds DESC) AS rank_for_day FROM sessions
)
SELECT (r.wake_date::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='light') / 3600.0 AS "Light",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='deep') / 3600.0 AS "Deep",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='rem') / 3600.0 AS "REM",
  SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.ends-s.starts))) FILTER (WHERE s.stage='awake') / 3600.0 AS "Awake"
FROM segmented s JOIN ranked r USING (session_id)
WHERE r.rank_for_day=1 AND r.wake_date BETWEEN (($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AND (($__timeTo())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date
GROUP BY r.wake_date ORDER BY r.wake_date

WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric, r.original_type, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) >= ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz-interval '6 days' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) <= ($__timeTo())::timestamptz
), by_source AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, source_name, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps
  FROM recent WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' GROUP BY 1,2
), daily AS (
  SELECT day, COALESCE(MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect'), MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Samsung Health')) AS steps
  FROM by_source GROUP BY day
), smoothed AS (
  SELECT day, steps, AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_7d FROM daily
)
SELECT (day::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time", steps AS "Steps", avg_7d AS "7d Avg"
FROM smoothed WHERE day >= (($__timeFrom())::timestamptz AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date ORDER BY day

SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(value_numeric) AS "active_energy"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'active_energy'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
  AND unit IN ('Cal', 'kcal')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (date_trunc('day', text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AS "time",
  SUM(value_numeric) AS "distance_m"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'distance'
  AND unit = 'm'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS "time",
  AVG(value_numeric) AS "spo2"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'oxygen_saturation'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
  AND unit = '%'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) AS "time",
  value_numeric AS "weight"
FROM health_observations_raw
WHERE metric_type = 'weight'
  AND unit = 'kg'
  AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) >= $__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(start_time) <= $__timeTo()
ORDER BY 1

SELECT v.metric_type AS "Metric", latest.observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AS "Latest observation (ET)", latest.source_name AS "Source", ROUND((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now()-latest.observed_at))/3600.0)::numeric,1) AS "Age (hours)"
FROM (VALUES ('steps'),('heart_rate'),('active_energy'),('distance'),('weight'),('resting_heart_rate'),('oxygen_saturation'),('sleep_segment'),('heart_rate_variability_rmssd'),('heart_rate_variability_sdnn')) v(metric_type)
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r LEFT JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type=v.metric_type
  ORDER BY text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) DESC LIMIT 1
) latest ON true
ORDER BY v.metric_type

targets.rawSql:
WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time) AS observed_at, r.value_numeric, r.original_type, s.source_name
  FROM health_observations_raw r JOIN health_sources s ON s.id=r.source_id
  WHERE r.metric_type='steps' AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)>=$__timeFrom() AND text_to_timestamptz_immutable(r.start_time)<=$__timeTo()
), daily AS (
  SELECT (observed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York')::date AS day, source_name, SUM(value_numeric) AS steps FROM recent WHERE original_type='health_sync_steps' GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT day AS "Local day", MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect') AS "Health Connect", MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Samsung Health') AS "Samsung Health", COALESCE(MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Health Connect'),MAX(steps) FILTER (WHERE source_name='Health Sync / Samsung Health')) AS "Canonical"
FROM daily GROUP BY day ORDER BY day DESC
